verdict_reason: Seed data correctly moves to commodity code plus Latin name matching the stub fixture, but the fish-line variant now seeds ostriches under a Fish id and the JSDoc still uses the retired commodity-name gate vocabulary.

todos.issue: The 'fish-line' variant now seeds commodity 01063300 'Struthio' (ostriches), yet its id (line 128) and comments (lines 79-83, 126-127) still say Fish; flow-reachability.test.js:156-162 looks it up by the same 'fish-line' id and calls it fish in its comment
todos.fix: Must: the variant id and every comment that names it describe the commodity it seeds (a commodity code with no identifiers), in seeds.js and in flow-reachability.test.js. One way: rename the id to 'unidentified-line' (or 'ostrich-line'), update the find() in flow-reachability.test.js and its title/comment, and reword the JSDoc and inline comment to say the code carries no identifier list

todos.issue: The seedVariants JSDoc (lines 74-77) still describes the gates in the retired commodity-name vocabulary: 'single Cow line', 'Horse-gated horseName', 'Cat/Dog-gated permanentAddress'. After this PR horseName is gated on code 0101 and permanentAddress on the species list in rules.js PERMANENT_ADDRESS_SPECIES (Felis catus, Canis familiaris, Canis lupus familiaris, Mustela putorius furo), which includes ferrets the comment omits
todos.fix: Must: the JSDoc names the gates by what now opens them (the commodity code, or code plus Latin name), or says nothing about them. One way: trim it to state what seedVariants returns, and let the per-variant one-line comments name the code or species each variant seeds

todos.issue: The seedVariants JSDoc names a release ('the corpus's only design-release-1 consignment', line 83); house rules ban release names in code and comments
todos.fix: Must: no release name in the comment. One way: delete 'design-release-1' and say 'the corpus's only consignment with no identification panel'
